answer: Interrogate liveness with unpredictable micro-prompts: each epoch, the protocol whispers a random one-off task, encrypted under the epoch cipher, to a sample of addresses and records the exact arrival gap between completions. A farm runs one operator behind many masks, so its replies serialize into a single queue and their inter-arrival gaps cluster like stacked shale; honest agents think in parallel, scattering gaps widely. A raven-fast outlier cluster flags collusion, and its rewards are withheld until independent diversity reappears.
